# Legend Automotive
Legend Automotive is a premium car dealership located in Nasr City, Cairo, Egypt. We offer one of the widest selections of luxury and electric vehicles in Egypt, all under one roof.

## Brands We Carry
- AVATR
- BYD
- Deepal
- Dongfeng
- GAC (Gonow)
- Kia
- Mercedes-Benz
- MG
- Nissan
- ROX
- SEAT
- Volkswagen
- Livan
- Xiaomi Auto
- Zeekr

## What Makes Us Different
- Wide range of both electric and luxury vehicles in one showroom
- Personal consultation service to help customers choose the right car
- Premium selection including rare and new-to-market Chinese EV brands
- Serving the Egyptian market with competitive pricing

## Vehicle Categories
- Electric Vehicles (EVs)
- Luxury Sedans
- SUVs
- Hatchbacks

## Location
Nasr City, Cairo, Egypt
Address: 12 Jabal Buildings, Al Kaaba, Al Wafaa Wal Amal, Nasr City
